mapper.sql: c.id, c.employee_user_id AS employeeUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(employee.display_name, ''), employee.username) AS employeeName, employee.email AS employeeEmail, c.applicant_user_id AS applicantUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(applicant.display_name, ''), applicant.username) AS applicantName, c.review_approver_user_id AS reviewApproverUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(reviewer.display_name, ''), reviewer.username) AS reviewApproverName, c.change_type AS changeType, c.effective_date AS effectiveDate, c.current_department_id AS currentDepartmentId, current_department.name AS currentDepartmentName, c.current_position_id AS currentPositionId, current_position.name AS currentPositionName, c.current_supervisor_user_id AS currentSupervisorUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(current_supervisor.display_name, ''), current_supervisor.username) AS currentSupervisorName, c.target_department_id AS targetDepartmentId, target_department.name AS targetDepartmentName, c.target_position_id AS targetPositionId, target_position.name AS targetPositionName, c.target_supervisor_user_id AS targetSupervisorUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(target_supervisor.display_name, ''), target_supervisor.username) AS targetSupervisorName, c.reason, c.status, c.decision_comment AS decisionComment, c.version, c.submitted_at AS submittedAt, c.decided_at AS decidedAt, c.withdrawn_at AS withdrawnAt, c.applied_at AS appliedAt, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt

JOIN app_user employee ON employee.id = c.employee_user_id AND employee.tenant_id = c.tenant_id JOIN app_user applicant ON applicant.id = c.applicant_user_id AND applicant.tenant_id = c.tenant_id JOIN app_user reviewer ON reviewer.id = c.review_approver_user_id AND reviewer.tenant_id = c.tenant_id LEFT JOIN department current_department ON current_department.id = c.current_department_id LEFT JOIN position current_position ON current_position.id = c.current_position_id LEFT JOIN app_user current_supervisor ON current_supervisor.id = c.current_supervisor_user_id LEFT JOIN department target_department ON target_department.id = c.target_department_id LEFT JOIN position target_position ON target_position.id = c.target_position_id LEFT JOIN app_user target_supervisor ON target_supervisor.id = c.target_supervisor_user_id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM employee_change c
WHERE ORDER BY c.submitted_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee_change c
WHERE
SELECT * FROM employee_change WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND applied_at IS NULL AND effective_date <= #{effectiveDate} ORDER BY effective_date, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
